thread.document:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hOqLiCQuekARSADubqDPQmFXNSsR01bsBQzjN4OUIpU/edit?gid=0#gid=0

The spreadsheet above has links to individual appointment calendars for the course staff along with what project topics we will be supporting. 

Please set up an appointment for next week. And then, once your project proposals are in, for the following week to get feedback.

Remember, these are required meetings for each group. At least one person from your group must attend the meeting.

 The appointments next week should help you find a problem and/or refine it.
